verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only mentions generic IAM overview docs (who can do what on which resource) but contains no documentation of GCP's project/folder/org hierarchy, sandbox environments, or Organization Policy guardrails that would let a developer isolate experiments from prod. Missing for 10: docs on resource hierarchy (orgs/folders/projects), sandbox project patterns, Organization Policy constraints, and any hands-on corroboration of isolation working as a guardrail.
